Package com.coachservice.app.mapper

Class CoachMapper

java.lang.Object
com.coachservice.app.mapper.CoachMapper
@Component public class CoachMapper extends Object
Mapper class responsible for converting between Coach entities and their corresponding Data Transfer Objects (DTOs).

This class provides methods to transform CoachInfoTransferDto into a Coach entity and vice versa. It also converts Coach entities into various DTOs used for different purposes such as showcasing information or aggregating coach details.

The CoachMapper uses services PillarService and DivisionService to retrieve additional details required for mapping. These services help in resolving entities like Pillar based on provided DTO data.

  • Method Details

    • coachDtoToCoach

      public Coach coachDtoToCoach(CoachInfoTransferDto coachDto)
      Converts a CoachInfoTransferDto to a Coach entity.

      This method maps the fields from the DTO to the corresponding fields in the Coach entity. It also resolves the Pillar and Division using their respective services based on the specialization and division names provided in the DTO.

      Parameters:
      coachDto - the CoachInfoTransferDto containing coach details
      Returns:
      a Coach entity populated with details from the DTO

    • coachToInfoShowcaseDto

      public InfoShowCaseDto coachToInfoShowcaseDto(Coach coach)
      Converts a Coach entity to an InfoShowCaseDto for showcasing purposes.

      This method extracts essential details from the Coach entity and maps them to the InfoShowCaseDto. It includes basic information such as name, image, division, and location details.

      Parameters:
      coach - the Coach entity to convert
      Returns:
      an InfoShowCaseDto containing essential information about the coach

    • coachToAggregatedCoachDto

      public AggregatedCoachDto coachToAggregatedCoachDto(Coach coach)
      Converts a Coach entity to an AggregatedCoachDto for aggregated data representation.
